The owner, 2026-11-16: Thalaba's own small sulfur deposit, 30 t a year, at the cataract's foot (Gāḍz-Phōl) where Godshearth's spillway cut the shield's old fumarole lines; worked by Salphar, the diggers' hamlet (settlements/thalaba/PLAN.md section 4).
